title: Standard cotangent differential augmentation
statement: For commutative rings $A,B$ and a ring map $f:A\to B$, use a coherence datum $D$ and its standard differential cochain complex $K$ from [def-trf-cotangent-resolution-data], with universal differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] and the degree-zero complex of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A standard differential augmentation is a chain map $a:K\to\Omega^1_{B/A}[0]$ whose degree-zero component sends $b\otimes\mathrm dx$ to $b\,\mathrm d(\epsilon(x))$ for every $b\in B$ and every element $x$ of the degree-zero standard polynomial ring. All its other components have zero target. This defines the specified augmentation data and their generator condition; it does not assert existence.
